title: The last ordinary morning
body: A transit notice is still cached in the terminal. Route 07 was to reopen on Monday. The waterfront market had requested two extra buses. Someone had added a reminder to collect their daughter after swimming lessons. None of these people knew they were leaving a record of the world.
note: Meridian, this record, and the 2033 catastrophe are fictional. This is a demonstration of how place-based discoveries will connect to essays, evidence, and clearly attributed sources.
